caller_shape.note: The inspected call sites show the caller-side contract: the caller tests end against capacity end itself and calls this helper only on the full path, passing the container in rdi, the insert position (the end, for appends) in rsi, and a pointer to the value in rdx.

capacity_rule.doubling_overflow_arm: when 2 * size wraps below size (unsigned), the native code takes the max-bytes allocation path: operator new(0x7ffffffffffffff8), with the capacity end recorded as the new buffer plus that byte count; that byte count equals maximum * 8, so the wrap path and the capped path end at the same capacity, and the model returns the maximum for both
capacity_rule.empty_container: end == begin: new capacity is size + 1 (== 1) elements, capped at the maximum; a wrapped size + 1 takes the max-bytes allocation path
capacity_rule.nonempty_container: new capacity is min(2 * size, 0x0fffffffffffffff) elements
capacity_rule.note: The helper always allocates a fresh buffer; there is no in-place arm even when spare capacity exists. Callers invoke it on their full path (end == capacity end), e.g. the transfer call site 0x5f13e8c, reached only after the transfer's own end == capacity-end test at 0x5f13e64.

container_layout.note: The helper reads begin and end only; it never reads the capacity field except at the delete step, where the freed byte count is capacity_end - begin. It writes begin, end and capacity_end at the end.

copy_steps_in_order: value = qword loaded from the rdx pointer
when (position - begin) > 0 (signed): memmove(new_buffer, old_begin, position - begin)
when (old_end - position) > 0 (signed): memcpy(destination_after_insert, position, old_end - position)
when old_begin != 0: operator delete(old_begin, old_capacity_end - old_begin)
store new_buffer to container +0x00, new_end to container +0x08, new_buffer + allocation_bytes to container +0x10

size_rule.definition: size = (end - begin) >> 3, arithmetic shift on the wrapped 64-bit difference
size_rule.length_error_arm: size == 0x0fffffffffffffff calls __throw_length_error with the rodata string at 0x43d55a ('vector::_M_realloc_insert'), noreturn
